messages:
maria: FYI - Acme tenant hitting intermittent 503s + p99 spikes on their dedicated GPU pool since ~2026-03-15T18:10Z. Need a debug harvest for repro. Request IDs + example curl below.

sam: Can you paste the request IDs and the time window? Also tenant/org id so we can scope logs.

maria: Tenant: acme-corp (tenant_id: tnt-acme-09). Window: 2026-03-15T18:08:00Z -> 2026-03-15T18:18:00Z. Request IDs: r-9f12a3b4, r-9f12a3b4-duplicate, r-9f12a3b4:retry1 (they tried a few retries).

lee: Quick checklist: 1) curl repro 2) pod logs (inference + sidecars) 3) node dmesg + kernel logs 4) nvidia-smi/DCGM snapshot 5) kubectl describe for pod/node 6) debug-harvest upload.

maria: curl repro (redacted token):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-v1","input":"summarize: short"}' \ 
  --header "X-Request-ID: r-9f12a3b4"
```

sam: Running pod log grab now. Which k8s namespace and pod name pattern?

maria: Namespace: dedicated-acme-09. Pods: inference-*-v2 (there are 3 replicas). Primary pod at the time was inference-0. Sidecar: envoy-proxy. Node: gpu-node-eu-17.

lee: Commands to collect quickly:
```bash
kubectl -n dedicated-acme-09 get pods -o wide
kubectl -n dedicated-acme-09 logs inference-0 --since=20m > /tmp/inference-0.log
kubectl -n dedicated-acme-09 logs inference-0 -c envoy-proxy --since=20m > /tmp/envoy-inference-0.log
kubectl -n dedicated-acme-09 describe pod inference-0 > /tmp/describe-inference-0.txt
ssh ubuntu@gpu-node-eu-17 'sudo dmesg --ctime | tail -n 200' > /tmp/node-dmesg.txt
ssh ubuntu@gpu-node-eu-17 'nvidia-smi -q -x' > /tmp/nvidia-smi.xml
# DCGM stats (if installed)
ssh ubuntu@gpu-node-eu-17 'sudo /opt/dcgm/dcgm-exporter/dcgm-exporter --snap' > /tmp/dcgm-snap.json
```

oncall-jordan: If kernel/XID errors show up in dmesg, also grab `/var/log/kern.log` and `journalctl -k -S "2026-03-15 18:00:00" --until "2026-03-15 18:30:00"`

maria: Doing the harvest using our internal tool: `/opt/redwood/bin/debug-harvest --tenant tnt-acme-09 --request-ids r-9f12a3b4 --since "2026-03-15T18:05" --until "2026-03-15T18:20" --output /tmp/acme-debug-2365.tar.gz`

ops-bot: @maria I started a debug-harvest job id dbg-20260315-001, it will collect pod logs, node snapshots, and GPU traces. Uploading to s3://redwood-debug-harvests/acme/dbg-20260315-001.tar.gz once complete.

sam: After we have the tar, please run a quick integrity check and then share the S3 link in the support ticket. Also include the CI trace or deployment id if available; might be related to yesterday's model rollout.

maria: Upload complete. s3://redwood-debug-harvests/acme/dbg-20260315-001.tar.gz (presigned link pasted into ticket). Items included: inference-0 logs, envoy logs, describe output, node dmesg + kern.log, nvidia-smi xml, dcgm snapshot, kubelet logs for the timeframe, and the request tracer logs for r-9f12a3b4.

lee: I'll pull the bundle and grep for XID, timeouts, and any GC/oomk activity. If we see repeated kernel GPU resets line up with p99 spikes, escalate to infra-ml.

oncall-jordan: Also note: customer reported billing anomaly during the same window. @sam can you cross-check cost spikes vs token volume? If billing produced retries that spiked concurrency it could explain saturation.

sam: On it - checking cost+quota logs for tnt-acme-09 between 18:00-18:30Z. Will post results in thread.

maria: Thanks team. If you need SSH creds for node, ping me off-thread and I'll rotate a short-lived key.

ops-bot: debug-harvest dbg-20260315-001: completed successfully, size 243MB, uploaded.

sam: Initial look - no kernel OOPS, but found repeated gRPC timeouts in envoy around 18:12Z and a couple of transient CUDA driver warnings. Pulling nvidia-smi and dcgm next.

lee: Good. If we can't repro locally with the curl above, next step is to run a load replay against the dedicated pool with the same request rate they reported (they said bursts ~120 QPS). Coordinate with QA for a safe canary run.

maria: Added replay notes to the ticket + customer consent for a controlled load test.

sam: Will post follow-up once DCGM snapshots parsed. Thanks everyone.
